home.heroTitle: Learners pay. Discord opens. You stay in control.
home.heroBody: Discelyn connects your training Stripe to a Discord role: access opens on payment, closes on refund or subscription end. 0% commission. Free trial on 1 training.
home.whySubtitle: Less manual access work, fewer access disputes, more time to sell and teach.
home.opsNote: Ops layer (welcome, tickets…) included — details on the features page.
home.betaProofTitle: Try it on your real training — free
home.betaProofBody: Wire 1 Stripe product → 1 role. Run a test payment, a claim, a test refund. If the flow doesn’t hold, you don’t upgrade.
home.stepsSubtitle: Built for orgs and creators who already train on Discord.
home.step1Body: Discord or email — you land straight in the dashboard.
home.step2Body: Pick your training price and the learner role. Discelyn wires the rest.
home.step3Body: Learner pays, claims Discord, gets the role. Refund or sub end: access removed.
home.diffTitle: Your Stripe. Your Discord. Your access rules.
home.diffSubtitle: Built to sell and deliver training — not to run a hobby community.
home.diffPublicBody: DIY webhooks or Zapier often open access. Rarely a clean revoke (refund, sub end, cohort end) and a Discord claim without staff tickets.
home.diffDiscelynBody: ≈ 5 minutes: Stripe → price + role → link. Money on your Stripe, 0% commission, access cut on refund or sub end.
home.diffProof1Body: Discelyn creates the Stripe connection and payment link for you.
home.diffProof2Body: Funds stay on YOUR Stripe. Discelyn takes no cut on your sales.
home.diffProof3Body: Learner access, cohort end, EU invoice — training ops, not gaming roles.
home.pricingTitle: A free trial. Plans that grow with you.
home.pricingSubtitle: Free trial (1 training) to validate payment → claim → revoke. Starter from €19.99/mo when sessions stack — 0% cut on your revenue. Cancel via Stripe.
home.ctaBody: Free trial on 1 training. Or ask a question — reply within 1 business day.

detail.claim: They connect Discord in one click.

preview.ticketBody: Private channel created. Staff notified. History kept.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Core: Stripe payment → Discord role. Around it: the ops layer to run training on Discord.
features.whySubtitle: Reliable access control, plus the minimum to operate a training Discord.
features.ctaTitle: Ready to wire Stripe to Discord?
features.ctaBody: Free trial: 1 access product. Configure from the dashboard.

access.d: On YOUR Stripe. Learner pays, claims Discord, gets the role. Refund = access cut.
access.detail: Access control is the core: open and close Discord based on payment.

revoke.d: Refund, unpaid, subscription end or cohort end: the Discord role is removed.
revoke.detail: You no longer rely on a manual forget to cut access.

zeroCut.d: Funds stay on your training Stripe account. No marketplace, no platform cut.
zeroCut.detail: You pay software — not a fee on every learner.

welcome.d: Welcome message + cohort role as soon as they join the server.
welcome.detail: Clean onboarding from the first message — after the claim.

mod.d: Warns in DB + preview; audit export from Starter.
mod.detail: History you can use for disputes or internal audits.

rgpd.d: Account export / delete, retention, Stripe EUR.
rgpd.detail: Org framing ready to sell in FR/EU.

dashboard.d: Configure Stripe→role and ops without pasting a token.
dashboard.detail: First useful screen: wire access, follow learners.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. Success = a test payment that opens a Discord role — not a module grid.
howItWorks.stepsSubtitle: From account to first paid access — plain language first.
howItWorks.scrollHint: Scroll or click a step above
howItWorks.needsSubtitle: Nothing exotic — Discord, your training Stripe, and ≈ 5 minutes.
howItWorks.ctaBody: Configure from the dashboard, upgrade via Stripe when you want. No Discord token to paste.
howItWorks.techBody: Under the hood: training Stripe key, webhook created for you, price → Discord role mapping, secure Discord claim, revoke on refund / sub end / cohort end.

01.d: Click Try, sign in with Discord or email. You land straight in the dashboard.

02.d: Pick your training price and the learner Discord role. Discelyn links payment to access — that’s the core product.

03.d: Choose your training server and invite the bot so it can grant and revoke access.

04.d: A test payment, the learner claims Discord, the role opens. A refund removes access. Only then: welcome / tickets.

account.d: The one you use to manage the training server.

server.d: Your community / cohort — with permission to invite a bot.

time.d: Account → Stripe → invite → first access. Upgrade whenever.
